I may not be the most skilled developer in the room today. But I’m ready to work hard to become one. 💻🚀

Let me be honest.

I’m at the beginning of my software development career. I still have a lot to learn, many problems to solve, and plenty of room to grow.

But one thing I can promise is this: I’m willing to put in the work.

I dont expect a company to hand me success. I’m looking for an opportunity where I can earn trust, learn from experienced developers, take feedback positively, and turn my knowledge into real-world skills.

My current focus is Java Development and Frontend Development.

I may not know everything a professional developer knows today, but I’m ready to ask questions, accept my mistakes, improve consistently, and give my 100% to the responsibilities entrusted to me.

Because I believe a good developer isn't built in a day. They're built through consistency, curiosity, teamwork, and the willingness to keep improving.

To every recruiter, HR professional, and hiring manager reading this:

If your team is looking for a fresher or intern who is honest about where he stands, serious about learning, and ready to work hard for an opportunity, I would love to connect.

I’m not asking anyone to overlook my current skill level. I’m asking for a chance to demonstrate my potential through my work.

Skills can grow with practice. Confidence grows with experience. And potential deserves a chance to prove itself.

One opportunity. One team. One chance to prove that investing in a fresher can be worthwhile. 🤝

📩 Open to Java Developer Internships and Frontend Developer Internships.
